## D — Space management
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Numerical passing figures are the handbook’s stated examples with all speed and approximation conditions retained. The temporary merging example is not presented as a substitute for the normal following interval. Road users’ errors do not create a new legal priority.
Dynamic disposition: Posted limits and any external postal-equipment requirement need current applicable authority; no new universal safe-gap guarantee is created.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.

corpus_stability.reason: This is a bounded snapshot of the issuer-linked Montana handbook. Its revision conflict is explicitly held as debt; there is no evidence in the supplied source of multiple substantive rewrites per year. Currency of individual changeable provisions is not inferred from this assessment.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page seventy-six temporary merge example leaves two seconds ahead/behind, while the normal following rule on page seventy-four uses three seconds. Continuing gap policy and safe application require clarification; no two-second continuing-safe-gap claim is asserted.

Physical page seventy-seven refers to a United States Postal Service rural-delivery emblem requirement without identifying its current rule. External postal applicability is unverified and not asserted.
